blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: In recent decades, artificial intelligence has made significant progress in understanding and interacting with images. One of the important applications of this technology is Visual Question Answering (VQA), a research field that requires computers to understand and answer questions about images in a natural manner. Despite extensive research and development in VQA for English, there have been very few similar efforts made for other languages, especially Vietnamese. This gap presents a significant challenge and opportunity for the advancement of VQA technology in the Vietnamese language context. By bridging this gap, the field of Vietnamese VQA not only enriches the diversity of research in artificial intelligence but also enables practical applications in various domains, such as education, healthcare, and entertainment, catering to Vietnamese-speaking populations worldwide. Thus, the exploration and development of Vietnamese VQA systems hold immense potential for advancing both research and practical applications in the intersection of computer vision and natural language processing. In this paper, we propose a Multi-layer Fusing Transformer model utilizing a cross attention module to combine multiple modality features of images and texts from different layers in an aggregated representation. Our architecture allows us extract information from low level to high level. Through detailed experiments and ablation studies, our model achieves promising results against the competitive baselines in ViVQA dataset for Vietnamese language.
blocks.zh: 近几十年来,人工智能在理解和与图像互动方面取得了重大进展. 这种技术的一个重要应用是视觉问答(VQA),这个研究领域要求计算机以自然的方式理解并回答有关图像的问题. 尽管对英语的VQA进行了广泛的研发,但对其他语言,尤其是越南语的类似努力却很少. 这一差距对越南语言背景下的VQA技术的进步提出了重大挑战和机会. 通过弥合这一差距,越南的VQA领域不仅丰富了人工智能研究的多样性,而且还使得在教育、保健和娱乐等各个领域的实际应用能够面向全世界讲越南语的人口。 因此,越南VQA系统的探索和开发具有巨大的潜力,可推动计算机视觉和自然语言处理的交叉研究和实际应用。 在本文中,我们提议采用多层引信变形器模型,利用交叉注意力模块,将不同层次的图像和文本的多模式特征结合起来,形成一个汇总的表示. 我们的架构让我们从低层到高层提取信息. 通过详细的实验和消减研究,我们的模型在越南语ViVQA数据集的竞争基线上取得了有希望的结果.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: In everyday life, humans effortlessly receive and interpret information from multiple sources simultaneously, including visuals, sounds, and textual data. For machines to mirror this complex human capability, they must be adept at processing a variety of signal types concurrently. The field of multi-modal research, especially tasks that combine vision and language, has seen significant growth in recent years, reflecting the increasing interest in understanding and developing systems that can interpret and respond to combined data inputs. Among the myriad of tasks within the realm of image and text multi-modal processing, activities such as Visual Question Answering (VQA), image captioning, text-to-image synthesis, and cross-modal retrieval have emerged as key areas of focus. Notably, Visual Question Answering (VQA) represents a cutting-edge intersection of research and practical application, showcasing the potential of integrating visual and linguistic features. VQA systems are designed to analyze images and comprehend questions about them, synthesizing information from both domains to produce accurate and relevant answers. This ability not only highlights advancements in artificial intelligence (AI) but also opens up new pathways for human-computer interaction, making VQA a critical area of study in the broader field of AI research.
blocks.zh: 在日常生活中,人类不遗余力地同时接收和解读来自多来源的信息,包括视觉,声音,和文字数据. 机器要反射这种复杂的人的能力,必须精通同时处理各种信号类型. 多式联运研究领域,特别是将远景和语言结合起来的任务,近年来有了显著增长,反映出人们越来越关注理解和发展能够解释和应对综合数据投入的系统。 在图像和文本多模式处理领域的众多任务中,诸如视觉问答、图像字幕、文本到图像的合成和跨模式检索等活动已成为重点领域。 值得注意的是,视觉问题回答(VQA)是研究与实际应用的一个尖端交叉点,显示了融合视觉和语言特征的潜力. VQA系统旨在分析图像并理解有关它们的问题,从两个领域合成信息以产生准确而相关的答案. 这种能力不仅突出了人工智能(AI)的进步,也开启了人与计算机互动的新途径,使VQA成为了更广泛的AI研究领域的一个关键研究领域.

blocks.en: Vietnamese is a widely spoken language with a rich visual culture, making it an important target for developing language-enabled AI systems. However, the development of VQA systems for Vietnamese faces unique challenges due to linguistic nuances, cultural contexts, and the scarcity of annotated datasets in the Vietnamese language. Existing VQA models trained on English-centric datasets may not generalize well to Vietnamese due to language differences and semantic variations.
blocks.zh: 越南语是广受欢迎的语言,具有丰富的视觉文化,成为开发语言化AI系统的重要目标. 然而,越南语VQA系统的发展由于语言细微,文化背景,越南语中附加注释的数据集稀缺而面临独特的挑战. 由于语言差异和语义变化,接受过以英语为中心的数据集培训的现有VQA模型可能无法很好地对越南语进行通俗化.

blocks.en: Therefore, the primary objective of this research is to design and develop a Vietnamese Visual Question Answering (VQA) system capable of understanding and accurately answering questions about visual content in the Vietnamese language. This system will leverage state-of-the-art techniques in computer vision and natural language processing, adapted and optimized for the Vietnamese language.
blocks.zh: 因此,这一研究的主要目的是设计和开发一个越南视觉问答(VQA)系统,能够理解和准确回答有关越南语视觉内容的问题. 这个系统将利用计算机视觉和自然语言处理方面最先进的技术,为越南语进行改造和优化.

blocks.en: This study introduces a novel method designed to enhance the performance of Vietnamese Visual Question Answering (VQA) systems. By addressing the specific challenges of processing visual content and natural language in the Vietnamese language, our proposed method aims to significantly improve the accuracy and reliability of VQA systems tailored for Vietnamese-speaking users. This advancement not only contributes to bridging the gap in language-centric AI technologies but also opens up new possibilities for the development of inclusive and culturally relevant AI applications for Vietnamese communities.
blocks.zh: 本研究引入了一种新的方法来提升越南视觉问答系统(VQA)的性能. 通过应对处理越南语视觉内容和自然语言的具体挑战,我们提出的方法旨在为越南语用户定制的VQA系统的准确性和可靠性得到显著提高. 这一进步不仅有助于缩小以语言为中心的人工智能技术的差距,而且为越南社区开发包容性和文化相关的人工智能应用程序开辟了新的可能性。

blocks.en: In prior models within the realm of deep learning, the emphasis has predominantly been on employing architectures featuring multiple hidden layers designed to meticulously extract and articulate both visual and linguistic features. Traditionally, these models have harnessed solely the attributes derived from the terminal layer as semantically enriched inputs for ensuing predictive analyses. The efficacy and robustness of such deep, multi-layered constructs are well-established and validated through extensive research across various domains. However, when addressing multi-modal challenges that necessitate the concurrent assimilation of both imagery and linguistic data, a sophisticated approach is not only requisite for the adept representation of features but also imperative for their harmonious integration. This integration aims to engender a more profound semantic synthesis. The conventional strategy of isolating features to the concluding layers of deep learning frameworks, thereby processing visual and textual streams in a segregated manner, inadvertently mitigates the potential for dynamic interaction between images and textual queries throughout the model’s learning trajectory.
blocks.zh: 在深入学习领域以前的模型中,重点主要是采用以多层隐藏为特征的建筑,旨在仔细地提取和阐明视觉和语言特征。 传统上,这些模型仅利用终端层产生的属性,作为随后预测性分析的集成内容。 这种多层次的深层构件的功效和稳健性通过各个领域的广泛研究得到了很好的确立和验证。 然而,在应对需要同时同化图像和语言数据的各种多式挑战时,不仅必须采用精密的方法来适当反映特征,而且必须采用这些特征的和谐结合。 这种整合旨在形成更深刻的语义综合. 传统的策略是将特征与深层学习框架的结束层相隔离,从而以隔离的方式处理视觉和文字流,无意中减轻了整个模型的学习轨迹中图像和文字询问之间动态互动的潜力。

blocks.en: In light of these considerations, our research introduces the innovative Multi-layer Fusing Transformer (MFT) model. This model is specifically architected to not only represent but also intricately weave together visual and textual features across the entirety of its processing layers. By doing so, the MFT model facilitates a more integrated and continuous interaction between these two pivotal dimensions. This novel approach marks a significant advancement in the field of Vietnamese Visual Question Answering, promising to elevate the efficacy of models tasked with deciphering and responding to complex visual-textual inquiries. Through this cutting-edge methodology, our work sets a new benchmark in multi-modal AI research, particularly in enhancing the comprehension and interpretative capabilities of systems engaging with the rich tapestry of Vietnamese visual and textual content.
blocks.zh: 鉴于上述考虑,我们的研究引入了创新的多层引信变形器模型。 这一模型的设计不仅代表了整个处理层的视觉和文字特征,而且复杂地相互交织在一起。 通过这样做,MFT模式促进了这两个关键层面之间更加一体化和持续的互动。 这种新颖的方法标志着越南视觉问题回答领域的重大进步,它保证提高负责破译和答复复杂视觉文字询问的模型的效率。 通过这一尖端方法,我们的工作为多式人工智能研究设定了新的基准,特别是在加强越南视觉和文字内容丰富的系统的理解和解释能力方面。

blocks.en: Section 2 reviews the background and relevant studies in Visual Question Answering (VQA) for Vietnamese, highlighting challenges and opportunities. Section 3 introduces our proposed VQA model for Vietnamese, detailing its architecture, components, and training methodology. Section 4 describes our experimental setup and evaluation, including the dataset, metrics, and comparative analysis with baseline models. Section 5 concludes with key findings, contributions to VQA research in Vietnamese, and future research directions.
blocks.zh: 第2节回顾了越南人视觉问题回答(VQA)的背景和相关研究,突出了挑战和机遇。 第3节介绍了我们提议的越南VQA模式,详细介绍了其结构、组成部分和培训方法。 第4节介绍了我们的试验设置和评价,包括数据集、衡量标准以及与基线模型的比较分析。 第5节最后提出了关键的调查结果、对越南语的VQA研究的贡献以及未来的研究方向。

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en: In recent years, interest in Visual Question Answering (VQA) in the Vietnamese language has significantly increased, with numerous studies exploring its potential and proposing new datasets as well as methods. In 2021, Tran and colleagues [ 6 ] introduced the first ViVQA dataset for VQA in Vietnamese, which has since become the standard in subsequent research.
blocks.zh: 近年来,对越南语的视觉问答(VQA)的兴趣大大增加,许多研究探索其潜力并提出了新的数据集和方法. 2021年,Tran和同事[6]在越南引进了第一个用于VQA的ViVQA数据集,这之后成为了后续研究的标准.

blocks.en: With the rapid development of technology and computers in recent years, Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) have achieved significant success in various applications. In 2017, the paper "Attention is all you need" by the authors Vaswani et al. [ 3 ] from Google brought a new wave to the field of natural language processing research. The authors introduced the architecture of Transformers, which, instead of following traditional approaches to text representation, utilizes the self-attention mechanism to estimate the weight of relationships between words in a text and then aggregates the representative information of a word with the weighted information of all words in the text. This implies that in the encoding process, the Transformers architecture can simultaneously process the entire input text without the need for recurrent iterations. At the end of 2018, based on the Transformers architecture, the pre-trained model BERT [ 1 ] was announced. BERT was proposed with the ability to train using semi-supervised learning methods, making model training easier and more effective in terms of semantic representation of sentences, marking a new milestone in building transferable language models. With the success of the Transformers architecture in natural language processing, many models based on this architecture have been applied to the field of computer vision, such as Vision Transformer (ViT) [ 2 ] and BeiT [ 8 ] , yielding promising results compared to models using CNNs.
blocks.zh: 随着近年来技术和计算机的迅速发展,深神经网络(DNNs)在各种应用上都取得了显著的成功. 2017年,由作者瓦斯瓦尼等撰写的论文"只需要你". [3] 从Google带入了自然语言处理研究领域的新浪. 作者引入了"变形人"架构,它没有遵循传统的方式来表达文本,而是利用自留机制来估计文本中单词之间关系的权重,再将一词的代表性信息与文本中所有单词的加权信息相加. 这意味着在编码过程中,变形器架构可以同时处理整个输入文本而无需反复重复. 2018年底,以"变形金刚"架构为基础,宣布了预训型号BERT [1]. 提出了利用半监督学习方法进行培训的能力BERT的建议,使示范培训在句子的语义表述方面更加容易和有效,标志着在建立可转移语言模型方面的一个新的里程碑。 随着变形器架构在自然语言处理上的成功,基于这种架构的许多模型被应用到计算机视觉领域,例如Vision Transformer (ViT) [2]和BeiT [8],与使用有线电视新闻网的模型相比,获得了有希望的成果.

blocks.en: Current approaches to the Vietnamese VQA problem utilize language and vision models trained on Vietnamese datasets. Notable examples include models like PAT [ 10 ] , BARTPhoBEiT [ 9 ] and Multi-vision Contextual Attention (MCA) model [ 15 ] , which are considered state-of-the-art (SOTA) for the VQA task on the ViVQA dataset [ 6 ] . While the PAT model utilizes Parallel Attention with a hierarchical feature extractor for questions, the BARTPhoBeiT model employs multiway transformers on the BardPho [ 12 ] and BeiT [ 8 ] models. Multi-vision Contextual Attention model simultaneously learns both global and local contextual visual features of the image and uses multi-branch contextual attention fusion that hierarchically integrates visual and textual features.
blocks.zh: 目前处理越南VQA问题的办法利用了越南数据集培训的语言和远景模型。 值得注意的例子包括PAT [10],BARTPhoBEIT [9]和多视背景注意(MCA)模型[15]等模型,这些模型被认为是VIVQA数据集VQA任务的最新(SOTA). 虽然PAT模型使用分级特征提取器进行分级注意,但BARTPhoBeiT模型在BardPho [12]和BeiT [8]模型上采用了多向变压器。 多视觉背景关注模式同时学习图像的全球和本地背景视觉特征,并使用多分支背景关注聚,分级融合了视觉和文字特征.

blocks.en: The findings from [ 13 ] confirm the intuitions researchers had about the hierarchical representations learned by deep architectures. Specifically, it reveals that the units in higher layers represent features that are significantly more complex and correspond to combinations of features from lower layers. And according to [ 14 ] , different layers of BERT exhibit various specializations, suggesting that it could be more beneficial to integrate information from multiple layers rather than selecting a single layer based solely on its overall performance.
blocks.zh: [13]的发现证实了研究者对从深层建筑学中吸取的分级表现的直觉. 具体地说,它揭示出高地层的单位代表了明显更复杂的特征,并对应了下地层特征的组合. 而根据 [14],BERT的不同层展现出不同的专业,暗示从多层整合信息比仅仅根据其整体性能选择一个单层更为有益.

blocks.en: 3 Our model
blocks.zh: 3个 我们的模特儿

blocks.en: We propose a new method utilizing cross-attention across different layers, called Multi-layer Fusing Transformer (MFT). Additionally, to ensure the model performs well on Vietnamese, we leverage language models that have been pretrained on large Vietnamese datasets. The MFT model consists of 4 main components: the Language Embedding Module, the Visual Embedding Module, the Cross-attention Module, and the Answer Selector (see Fig. 2 ). The following section will describe in detail the architecture of the model.
blocks.zh: 我们提出一种新方法,使用跨不同层的交叉注意,称为多层引信变形器。 此外,为确保该模型在越南语上运行良好,我们利用在越南大数据集上预先培训过的语言模型。 MFT模型由4个主要部分组成:语言嵌入模块,视觉嵌入模块,交叉出勤模块,以及答题选择器(见图2. 下一节将详细说明模型的结构。

blocks.en: 3.1 Language Embedding Module
blocks.zh: 3.1 语言嵌入模块

blocks.en: We use PhoBert [ 5 ] , the pre-trained language model utilized as the Language Embedding Module in our Visual Question Answering (VQA) system. PhoBERT is built upon the Transformer architecture, a powerful neural network architecture renowned for its effectiveness in natural language processing tasks. The Transformer model consists of multiple layers of self-attention mechanisms and feedforward neural networks, allowing it to capture long-range dependencies and contextual information from input sequences. Specifically, PhoBERT employs a multi-layer bidirectional Transformer encoder architecture. Each layer of the encoder consists of self-attention mechanisms, which enable the model to weigh the importance of different words in the input sequence based on their contextual relevance. Additionally, each layer includes feedforward neural networks for feature transformation and activation functions for non-linear mapping. The architecture of PhoBERT allows it to generate contextualized embeddings for words and sentences, capturing the semantic relationships and nuances of the Vietnamese language effectively.
blocks.zh: 我们使用PhoBert[5],即我们视觉问答(VQA)系统中用作语言嵌入模块的预训语言模型. PhoBERT是建立在变形器架构上,这是一种强大的神经网络架构,以在自然语言处理任务中的有效性而出名. 变形器模型由多层自留机制和向导神经网络组成,使其能够从输入序列中捕取远程依赖性和上下文信息. 具体而言,PhoBERT采用了多层双向变形器编码器架构. 编码器的每一层由自发机制组成,这使得模型能够根据其上下文的相关性来权衡输入序列中不同词的重要性. 此外,每层都包括用于地物转化的向导神经网络和用于非线性映射的活化功能. PhoBERT的架构使得它能够生成文字和句子的上下文嵌入,有效地捕捉越南语的语义关系和细微差别.

blocks.en: PhoBERT is pre-trained on a large corpus of Vietnamese text data using self-supervised learning techniques. The combination of the Transformer architecture and the self-supervised learning objectives enables PhoBERT to learn rich and meaningful representations of the Vietnamese language, making it well-suited for various downstream tasks, including Visual Question Answering.
blocks.zh: PhoBERT在大量越南文字数据上进行预训,使用自我监督的学习技术. "变形"架构与自控学习目标的结合,使PhoBERT能够学习越南语丰富而有意义的表现,使其非常适合各种下游任务,包括视觉问答.

blocks.en: 3.2 Visual Embedding Module
blocks.zh: 3.2 视觉嵌入模块

blocks.en: The design of ViT draws inspiration from the success of the BERT [ 1 ] model in natural language processing. Just as BERT revolutionized NLP by capturing bidirectional context in text sequences, ViT leverages the Transformer architecture to capture global and local context in visual data. Specifically, ViT adapts the self-attention mechanism from BERT to process image patches, enabling it to model complex relationships among visual elements effectively. By treating images as sequences of patches and applying self-attention across these patches, ViT achieves state-of-the-art performance in various computer vision tasks.
blocks.zh: ViT的设计从BERT[1]模式在自然语言处理中的成功中汲取了灵感. 正如BERT通过在文本序列中捕捉双向上下文而革命了NLP一样,VIT利用变形器架构在视觉数据中捕捉全球和局部上下文. 具体来说,VIT将BERT的自留心机制调整为处理图像补丁,使其能够有效模拟视觉元素之间的复杂关系. 通过将图像作为补丁的序列对待,并在这些补丁之间应用自觉,VIT在各种计算机视觉任务中实现了最先进的性能.

blocks.en: 3.3 Cross-attention Module
blocks.zh: 3.3 交叉学习单元

blocks.en: Figure 1: Architecture of Cross-Attention
blocks.zh: 图1:交叉留置结构

blocks.en: Taking inspiration from the VilBERT [ 4 ] , we employ a cross-attentional transformer layer to effectively integrate information between the question and the image, yielding a representation vector used for answer classification. Each layer has two sub-layers. The initial layer comprises a multi-head cross-attention mechanism, while the subsequent layer consists of a straightforward, fully connected feed-forward network applied position-wise. In the first layer, one modality’s representation is used as the Key and Value vectors, while the other modality’s representation serves as the Query vector. The d k d_{k} represents the attention dimension. Using cross-attention fusion layers, both modalities can acquire pertinent and supplementary contextual representations from each other. We utilize a residual connection surrounding each of the two sub-layers, succeeded by layer normalization.
blocks.zh: 其中下标t分别指文字表示和v指视觉表示. Kt T\ mathbf{K_{t}}^{T} 是矩阵 K t\ mathbf{K_{t}}t}}. d k d_{k 代表着关注的维度. 两种模式都利用跨注意力聚变层,可以相互获取相关和补充的背景表述。 我们利用两个子层的每个部分的剩余连接,继而通过层层正常化。

blocks.en: We perform cross-attention taking as input the outputs of language and image processing models at different layers. To integrate information from simple to complex from the two models, representation vectors at the beginning, middle, and end positions (corresponding to layers 0, 6, 12) are fed into the cross-attention layers. The representation vectors are averaged for both the text and vision parts, and the vector corresponding to the position of the [CLS] token of each part is concatenated together and passed through a pooling layer followed by a softmax operation to obtain probabilities for each answer.
blocks.zh: 我们采用不同层次的语言和图像处理模型的产出作为输入。 为了从两个模型中从简单到复杂的信息整合,将初始,中,末端位置(对应地层0,6,12)的表示向量被输入到交叉注意地层. 表示向量在文字和视觉部分均被平均,与每个部分的[CLS]令牌位置相对应的向量被调和在一起并经过一个集合层,然后进行软max操作以获得每个答案的概率.

blocks.zh: 图2:多层引信变换器:在不同层次使用预先训练的语言模型和视觉模型

blocks.en: 3.4 Answer Selector
blocks.zh: 3.4 答题选择器

blocks.en: The Answer Selector module fuses visual features h v ′ h^{\prime}_{v} and linguistic features h t ′ h^{\prime}_{t} to produce fused features h f ′ h^{\prime}_{f} . These fused features are then projected into the vocabulary space, resulting in a probabilistic vector that indicates the most likely candidate answer.
blocks.zh: 答案选择模块将视觉特征h v ' h^{\prime}_{v}和语言特征h t' h^{\prime}_{t}以产生被引信的特征h f′prime}_{f}. 这些已接合的特性随后被投射入词汇空间,从而产生概率矢量,表明最有可能的候选答案.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: In this section, we conduct a series of experiments to evaluate the performance of our proposed MFT models alongside established state-of-the-art (SOTA) models. Our experiments are conducted on the ViVQA dataset [ 6 ] , chosen for its relevance and suitability for assessing the efficacy of visual question answering systems. We provide comprehensive details regarding the implementation process and the selection of evaluation metrics, ensuring a fair and rigorous comparison between our models and existing benchmarks on the same dataset.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们进行了一系列实验,以评估我们提议的MFT模型与已确立的最先进模型的性能。 我们的实验是在ViVQA数据集 [6] 上进行的,其选择的相关性和适宜性用于评估视觉问答系统的功效. 我们提供了关于执行进程和评价衡量标准选择的全面细节,确保将我们的模型与同一数据集上的现有基准进行公正和严格的比较。

blocks.en: 4.1 Dataset
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集

blocks.en: The ViVQA dataset, created for Vietnamese Visual Question Answering (VQA), addresses the lack of resources in this domain despite the growing interest in VQA within natural language processing and computer vision communities. It consists of 10,328 images paired with 15,000 questions and answers in Vietnamese, facilitating the evaluation of VQA models tailored for the Vietnamese language. The dataset is divided randomly into training and test sets at an 8:2 ratio. These questions are categorized into types such as Object, Number, Color, and Location, and distributed across the train and test sets as shown in the Table 1
blocks.zh: 为越南Visual Question Answering(VQA)所创建的ViVQA数据集,解决了尽管自然语言处理和计算机视觉界对VQA的兴趣越来越大,但这个领域缺乏资源的问题. 它由10,328张图像与15,000个越南语的问答对接而成,为针对越南语的VQA模型的评价提供了便利. 数据集以8:2的比例随机分解为培训和测试集. 如表1所示,这些问题分为对象、数量、颜色和位置等类型,在列车和测试组之间分布。

blocks.en: 4.2 Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 4.2 评价计量

blocks.en: Following Rajpurkar et al. [ 7 ] , we use two evaluation metrics: F1 score and Exact Match. The F1 score serves as a crucial metric in assessing the performance of visual question answering models. It quantifies the average overlap between predicted and ground truth answers, treating them as bags of tokens to compute their F1 score. Specifically, the F1-score for each answer is computed based on the tokens of both the gold answer (GA) and the predicted answer (PA), ensuring a comprehensive evaluation. This calculation is performed for each question within the dataset, with the overall F1 score being averaged across all questions to provide a comprehensive assessment of model performance. In the context of Vietnamese VQA, F1 scores are calculated based on tokenized versions of the answers, facilitating precise evaluation and comparison across different models and datasets. Exact Match evaluates the proportion of predictions that exactly match any of the ground truth answers.
blocks.zh: 继Rajpurkar等 [7],我们使用两个评价度量衡:F1分和Exact Match. F1分数是评估视觉问答模型性能的关键衡量标准. 它将预测的和地面真实答案之间的平均重叠量量化,把它们当作一袋符来计算它们的F1分. 具体而言,每个答案的F1-分数都是根据黄金答案(GA)和预测答案(PA)的符号来计算的,以确保全面的评价. 这一计算是在数据集内对每个问题进行的,所有问题的F1总分均值为平均值,以便对模型性能进行全面评估。 就越南VQA而言,F1分数根据象征性的答案版本来计算,便于精确地评价和比较不同模型和数据集. 精确匹配(Exact Match)评价准确匹配任何地面真相答案的预测比例.

blocks.en: 4.4 Results
blocks.zh: 4.4 结果

blocks.en: Because there are few studies on Visual Question Answering (VQA) for Vietnamese, there are also few methods for this problem since the ViVQA dataset was published. In this section, we will compare the MFT model with recent SOTA models on the ViVQA dataset, including the Parallel Attention Transformer (PAT) [ 10 ] , BARTPhoBeiT [ 9 ] and Multi-vision Contextual Attention (MCA) model [ 15 ] . For these models, the results are extracted from the publication of these models. The details of the comparison are presented in Table 3 .
blocks.zh: 由于对越南人的视觉问题回答(VQA)的研究很少,因此自ViVQA数据集被发布以来,这个问题也几乎没有方法. 在本节中,我们将比较MFT模型与ViVQA数据集上最近的SOTA模型,包括平行关注变换器[10],BARTPhoBEiT[9]和多视背景关注(MCA)模型[15]. 对于这些模型,结果取自这些模型的出版. 比较详情见表3。

blocks.en: Table 3: The comparison of our model and competitive baselines (test-standard)
blocks.zh: 表3:我们模型和竞争性基线的比较(测试标准)

blocks.en: In comparison to existing models in the field, our proposed Multi-layer Fusing Transformer (MFT) model exhibits notable advantages across various performance metrics. While current state-of-the-art (SOTA) models have demonstrated commendable performance in Vietnamese Visual Question Answering (VQA) tasks, our MFT model surpasses them in terms of both F1-score and Exact metric. Specifically, when compared to the best-performing version of the BARTPhoBeit model, MFT showcases a significant improvement, achieving a 4% higher F1-score. Moreover, in terms of the Exact metric, our proposed model exhibits a similarly substantial lead of 4% over the PAT model. These results underscore the effectiveness and superiority of the MFT model in capturing intricate semantic relationships between visual and textual inputs, thereby enabling more accurate and nuanced responses in VQA tasks. Additionally, the innovative cross-attention mechanism integrated across different layers within the MFT architecture enhances its capability to effectively fuse information from both modalities, leading to superior performance outcomes. Overall, the comparative analysis highlights the MFT model’s potential as a leading solution in advancing the state-of-the-art in Vietnamese VQA research.
blocks.zh: 与实地现有模型相比,我们提议的多层引信变压器模型在各种业绩计量中显示出显著优势。 虽然目前最先进的(SOTA)模型在越南视觉问答(VQA)任务中表现出了值得称道的表现,但我们的MFT模型在F1分分和精确度量上都超过了它们. 具体地说,与BARTPhoBeit模式的最佳版本相比,MFT表现出了显著的改进,实现了4%的F1分高. 此外,从精确度衡量标准来看,我们提议的模型也显示出比PAT模型领先4%的同样实质性的领先。 这些结果突出了MFT模型在捕捉视觉输入和文字输入之间错综复杂的语义关系方面的有效性和优越性,从而使得VQA任务中能有更准确和细微的反应. 此外,在MFT架构内不同层面整合的创新性交叉注意机制,增强了其有效将两种模式的信息接通的能力,从而导致更好的绩效结果。 总体来说,比较分析突出了MFT模型作为推进越南VQA研究先进水平的主要解决方案的潜力.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In conclusion, this study presents a novel approach aimed at enhancing the performance of Vietnamese Visual Question Answering (VQA) systems. By addressing the unique challenges associated with processing visual content and natural language in the Vietnamese language, our proposed method significantly improves the accuracy and reliability of VQA systems tailored for Vietnamese-speaking users. The Multi-layer Fusing Transformer (MFT) model, introduced in this study, outperforms existing models in the field across various performance metrics. Specifically, compared to state-of-the-art models such as BARTPhoBeit and PAT, our MFT model demonstrates a notable improvement, achieving a 4% higher F1-score and Exact metric. These results highlight the effectiveness of the MFT model in capturing complex semantic relationships between visual and textual inputs, leading to more accurate and nuanced responses in VQA tasks. The innovative cross-attention mechanism integrated across different layers within the MFT architecture further enhances its capability to fuse information from both modalities, resulting in superior performance outcomes. Overall, our findings underscore the potential of the MFT model as a leading solution in advancing Vietnamese VQA research, while also paving the way for the development of inclusive and culturally relevant AI applications for Vietnamese communities.
blocks.zh: 最后,本研究提出了一种新颖的方法,旨在提高越南视觉问答系统的性能。 通过应对与越南语处理视觉内容和自然语言相关的独特挑战,我们提出的方法大大提高了针对越南语用户的VQA系统的准确性和可靠性. 本研究中引入的多层引信变形器(MFT)模型在各种性能度量度上超越了外地的现有模型. 具体来说,与BARTPhoBEit和PAT等最先进的模型相比,我们的MFT模型显示出了显著的改善,实现了4%的F1分和精确度的测量标准。 这些结果凸显出MFT模型在捕捉视觉输入和文字输入之间复杂的语义关系方面的有效性,导致VQA任务中更准确更细微的响应. 在MFT架构中跨出不同层次的创新性交叉关注机制可进一步提高其将两种模式的信息连接起来的能力,从而产生更好的绩效结果。 总的来说,我们的调查结果强调了MFT模式作为推动越南VQA研究的主要解决办法的潜力,同时也为越南社区开发包容性和文化上相关的AI应用铺平了道路.
